_about: Effective city-drain capacity used by the app (mm/h on a fully built cell, scaled by the built share). Calibrated on the 1 Jan 2020 flood, checked on 20 Feb 2021 and 4 Mar 2025 (verification/observed/scores-*-imerg.json).
result: every value above 0 lowered the share of reports hit and the flooded area fell below the reported 156 km2; 0 is used
caveat: IMERG averages rain over 0.1 degree cells (166 mm at the Halim cell vs 377 mm at the gauge): missing drains and smoothed rain can offset each other, one event cannot separate them
micro_note: South Jakarta micro drains with recorded sizes (pipeline/micro_drains.py): off until the three-flood test is in (validate.yml micro axis).
pumps_note: Validation 2026-11-01 (scores-*-imerg-v4.json): polder pumps on lowered the share of reports hit (2020: 72 -> 65 %, 2021: 78 -> 77 %, 2025: 81 -> 81 %) and the flooded area further below the reported one (2020: 87 -> 68 km2 vs 156 reported); the app starts with the pumps off and offers them as a switch.
